title: BB [[144,12,12]], Bravyi's schedule
description: One syndrome round of the bivariate-bicycle [[144,12,12]] code in Bravyi et al.'s schedule (Fig. 5 of arXiv:2308.07915): one ancilla per check, so 144 data ions and 144 check ions, and 864 two-qubit gates in the schedule's order, which every programme on the board keeps.
note: circuit.qasm is release bb144@2's circuit, byte for byte: one round of 288 qubits (q0..q143 data, q144..q215 X checks, q216..q287 Z checks) with its 864 CNOTs in the schedule's order. Every seed entry was compiled from it with qccdc cd3efedbbc10, which keeps each qubit's gates in that order. Until 2026-11-02 this task was release bb144@1, a 168-qubit round with 24 ancillas reused by mid-circuit measurement, and its seed entries were compiled from ancilla-layout variants of that round.
